title: AFK Area
details: It gives the player rewards the longer they stay there
Currently it gives 1 FazCoin every 25 seconds, and 1 Remnant every 2 minutes

title: Chapters
details: Chapters hold each level in the Main Game
Each Chapter contains new levels, rewards, and enemies

title: Daily Case
details: The Daily Case offers 5 different rewards, 1 being a legendary unit
Every day the player gets 1 spin, and is maxed out at 3

title: Exclusive Unit
details: An Exclusive Unit can be bought with FazCoins when available
The Current Exclusive Unit can change with Major Updates

title: Fazdex
details: This is a way to track progress with collecting units
Players can also select a unit to show off on their name tag

title: Mods
details: Mods allow you to upgrade your units with a boost
Mods can be rolled with Remnant, and can be auto skipped

title: Summons
details: This is the main way to get units, which uses FazCoins
The main summon pool changes every 30 minutes with new units

title: Teasers
details: This shows images and objects on a table that tease at the details of the next major update
Usually is changed or added to with every major update

title: Unit Quests
details: These quests are permanent milestones that reward the player with a unit
They can also be reclaimed for a charge of FazCoins at any time
